m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You have come to prevent a death. You do not understand: Life and Death are not opposites. They are different segments of the great Wheel.
So why not let this girl die? It is the Way. The Wheel spins: the matter of her body will nourish new life. This is not to be feared.
You don't understand - this isn't just any girl! If she dies it could mean the end of everything!
Wizard I want to consult with the Elder a little more. You go get ready to go - I'll catch up
Why do you want to do that? Death is just a part of the cycle. You have to free your minds. Go talk to our Elder - she'll help you.
You convinced the Elder? All right all right all right. What you're doing must be really important. You need to get to the Cave of Quickening.
Here's how it works: Life Energy shines from the Temple of Light onto the Great Wheel at the Cave of Quickening. But the Wheel moves.
At this time, the Cave of Quickening is in the middle of the Dying Jungles where Death Energies are strong - you'll die without protection.
You need to be purified. Talk to Gazhaat, in the market. He can help.
To our limited perceptions, time is a line, from the past to the future. Life and Death, they look like two different things. But they're not.
From outside a mortal vantage point, existence is a flattened circle, a Wheel. Raven made the ring of Mandalla to remind us of that forever.
This is Samsara, the center of my people's great work. I sense something very important brought you here - how can we Kalamar help?
This girl is dying - she needs your help! The Chain is why we're here. We need to fill her with the Chain's Life magic to keep her alive.
You want to save this girl? Just go see our Elder.
